8th Pay Commission insider gives update on increments with '100%' certainty 
 inshorts 8th Pay Commission insider gives update on increments with '100%' certainty
 Central government employees and pensioners will get arrears under the Eighth Pay Commission from January 1, 2026, said National Council-Joint Consultative Machinery (NC-JCM) staff side's Secretary SG Mishra. "I'm 100% sure of this. If anyone is saying otherwise, we shouldn't believe it," Mishra said.
